subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this broad Anthropic signed-thinking replay issue remain the canonical umbrella until prevention lands, or should maintainers close it in favor of the narrower completed-turn issue https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 now that recovery-carrier fixes are on main?
rationale: The remaining fix is not just a mechanical recovery predicate change; it changes which signed thinking blocks OpenClaw replays for Anthropic models and has provider/session compatibility tradeoffs already visible on open PRs.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue only after posting a handoff that makes https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining prevention tracker.

options.title: Defer Prevention Policy
options.body: Treat recovery as sufficient for now and move prevention to a later provider replay design review, accepting that thinking-enabled Anthropic sessions remain exposed to one-shot replay failures.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the selected prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame points to vincentkoc carrying the present recovery/replay helper shape, making him the best available routing owner for a policy choice across these source files.
